shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for persistent content containers.

shadows.name: scrolled-navigation-lift
shadows.purpose: Temporary lift for navigation after scrolling.

motion.name: navigation-transition
motion.purpose: Transition between resting and scrolled navigation states.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action control for creating, browsing, or advancing a recipe task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(149 31% 25%); color: hsl(42 40% 99%); font: 500 14px/20px DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(149 31% 21%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(149 31% 25%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action control that keeps visual emphasis on the primary route.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(149 31% 25%); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(42 40% 99%); color: hsl(149 31% 25%); font: 500 14px/20px DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(145 18% 92%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(149 31% 25%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard text field for recipe names, filters, and ingredient entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: hsl(150 22% 15%); font: 500 14px/20px DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(42 18% 84%); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(42 40% 99%); color: hsl(150 22% 15%); font: 400 14px/20px DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(150 8% 39%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(149 31% 25%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recipe Card
components.description: Plain, bordered container for persistent recipe content and grouped actions.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid hsl(42 18% 84%); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(42 40% 99%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); color: hsl(150 22% 15%); font-family: DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: hsl(150 8% 39%); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Accent Badge
components.description: Small metadata or feature marker with the system’s rare rose accent.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border: 1px solid hsl(18 64% 48% / 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(18 64% 48% / 0.1); color: hsl(18 64% 48%); font: 600 12px/16px DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Scrolled Navigation
components.description: A compact floating navigation state that appears only after page scroll.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(42 18% 84%); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(42 40% 99% / 0.7); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); color: hsl(150 22% 15%); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); font: 600 18px/28px DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(149 31% 25%); color: hsl(42 40% 99%); font: 500 14px/20px DM Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: hsl(149 31% 21%); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(149 31% 25%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Forked Recipe Book is a quiet personal utility, not a content marketplace. Its visual system makes recipes feel kept and useful: oat-toned surfaces, a deep herb-ink working color, a quietly expressive display face, and a deliberately small set of dependable controls. A rare persimmon accent adds a small human spark.

The interface is minimal without becoming sterile. Content gets generous space, cards stay plain, and responsive behavior preserves straightforward scanning. Illustration, when owned and introduced, should feel like a small pantry companion rather than generic food photography or decorative stock content.
keyCharacteristics: Oat-toned foundations with a deep herb-ink working color.
Flat-by-default utility surfaces with soft lift only where state or grouping needs it.
Friendly, tactile controls with rounded but compact geometry.
DM Serif Display for memorable headings and DM Sans for effortless reading.

rules.name: The One Spark Rule
rules.body: Persimmon is an accent, not a competing primary color. Use it for small badges and clear highlights; Herb Ink remains the working color.

rules.name: The Readable Recipe Rule
rules.body: Prefer the simplest established weight and size that makes recipe content scannable; decorative type must never compete with ingredients or steps.

rules.name: The Earned Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation appears to clarify hierarchy or interaction state, never to make every surface look important.

dos: Do let recipes, ingredients, and instructions remain the strongest content on any working screen.
Do use Oat Paper for broad breathing spaces and Clean Counter for interactive surfaces.
Do reserve Persimmon for small highlights and Herb Ink for meaningful actions.
Do use borders and spacing before adding shadows to explain hierarchy.
Do favor owned Notion-like illustration selectively over user-uploaded food imagery.
donts: Don't introduce ads, noisy promotional modules, or marketplace-style clutter.
Don't make Persimmon the dominant background, button, or navigation color.
Don't add user-uploaded recipe photography as a default content layer.
Don't stack large shadows or glossy effects onto everyday cards and fields.
Don't compress recipe instructions or ingredient lists merely to make a layout feel denser.
